in_arabic.name: شفيقه
in_arabic.long_meaning: شفيقه هي اسم علم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل شَفِقَ الذي يعني الحنو والرحمة، ويتضمن هذا الاسم القدرة على الشفقة والرحمة واللطف مع الآخرين، وهو اسم ذو دلالة إيجابية في التراث الإسلامي

in_urdu.name: شفیقہ
in_urdu.meaning: محبت کرنے والی اور نرم دل
in_urdu.long_meaning: شفیقہ نام کا مطلب ہے محبت کرنے والی اور نرم دل، یہ نام عربوں کے شَفِقَ سے ماخوذ ہے جو محبت اور رحم کے معنی دیتا ہے، یہ نام اسلامی روایت میں بہت اچھا سمجھا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: शफ़ीक़ा

in_hindi.long_meaning: शफ़ीक़ा नाम का अर्थ है प्रेम करने वाली और नरम दिल, यह नाम अरबी शफ़क से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है प्रेम और करुणा, इस नाम का महत्व इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत अच्छा माना जाता है

data.cultural_impact: The name Shafeeqah has a rich cultural significance in the Islamic world. It is derived from the Arabic root "Shafaqa," which means "to be content" or "to be satisfied." In Islamic culture, being content and thankful for what Allah has given us is considered a virtue. The name Shafeeqah thus conveys a sense of inner peace and fulfillment, and is a reminder to always be thankful for the blessings that Allah bestows upon us. It is also a name that is often given to girls, reflecting the importance of contentment and inner happiness in the Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Shafeeqah holds great significance as it represents a state of inner peace and satisfaction with Allah's will. This deeply spiritual concept is central to Islamic teachings, emphasizing the importance of being content with what Allah has given us and trusting in His plan for us. By adopting this name, one is reminded of the spiritual journey towards self-contentment and inner peace, which is a crucial aspect of Islamic spirituality and a key to achieving a closer relationship with Allah. Ultimately, the name Shafeeqah signifies a profound connection to the Divine and a deep sense of gratitude and appreciation for the blessings of Allah, both worldly and spiritual.
